Q: Bad parameter when using wdLine in MoveStart command A:

Assuming you're just looking for text in "regular" (non-table) content, then this worked for me. Code is in Word, but you can adapt to Excel.

Sub Transfer_Org_COM()

    Dim doc As Word.Document, rng As Word.Range
    
    Set doc = ActiveDocument
    Set rng = doc.Content
    
    With rng.Find
        .Forward = True
        .Text = "Current Permanent Home Address:"
        If .Execute() Then
            rng.Collapse direction:=WdCollapseDirection.wdCollapseStart
            rng.Move unit:=wdParagraph
            rng.MoveEnd unit:=wdParagraph
            Debug.Print rng.Text
        End If
    End With
    
End Sub

Q: Dealing with lack of non-null assertion operator in Python A:

I found two ways that I think get close to a non-null assertion operator and therefore cast type User|None to User:

1) Use typing.cast

from typing import cast

emails = [cast(User, get_user(uuid)).email for uuid in user_uuids]

2) Imitate non-null assertion with function

For Python 3.12+:

def not_none[T](obj: T | None) -> T:
    assert obj is not None
    return obj

emails = [not_none(get_user(uuid)).email for uuid in user_uuids]

or older Python versions:

from typing import Optional, TypeVar

T = TypeVar('T')

def not_none(obj: Optional[T]) -> T:
    assert obj is not None
    return obj

emails = [not_none(get_user(uuid)).email for uuid in user_uuids]

Q: Date time day light saving issue in java 8 for time zone Australia/Melbourne A:

Looking at DST transitions for Australia/Melbourne, the clock was never 02:00 on 2019-10-06 because of the DST change. This is how DST works: after 01:59:59.999999 the clock jumps to 03:00:00.000000.

This is documented in ZonedDateTime.of javadoc:

In the case of a gap, when clocks jump forward, there is no valid offset. Instead, the local date-time is adjusted to be later by the length of the gap. For a typical one hour daylight savings change, the local date-time will be moved one hour later into the offset typically corresponding to "summer".

See Wikipedia, Time in Australia.

Q: How can I toggle the GitHub Copilot Chat panel in VS Code using a keyboard shortcut? A:

If not planning to use Copilot, disabling or uninstalling the GitHub Copilot extension is the cleanest way.

Q: SQL count multiple columns and combine columns count A:

You want to use the origin language in case the requested language is null. In SQL, this is done with COALESCE.

SELECT
  COALESCE(requested_lang, origin_lang) AS language,
  COUNT(requested_lang) AS count_requested,
  COUNT(*) - COUNT(requested_lang) AS count_origin,
  COUNT(*) as total
FROM gpa_data
WHERE csvname = :csvname 
GROUP BY COALESCE(requested_lang, origin_lang)
ORDER BY COALESCE(requested_lang, origin_lang);

Demo: https://dbfiddle.uk/_OgMhx9W
